auditResult.statement: Preserved records are internally consistent and independently reproduce the negative result. This forensic consistency audit does not convert the failed frozen acceptance gate into a pass.

checksPerformed.detail: Retrieved GitHub artifact metadata for run 44762948524; artifact ID, name, byte size, digest, source head and branch matched the supplied provenance.
Independently hashed the downloaded ZIP; its SHA-256 matched the digest in GitHub artifact metadata.
Checked all six non-directory ZIP members have relative non-traversing paths and extracted contents exactly match ZIP member bytes.
Observed exactly one START, 36 TRIAL and one SUMMARY JSON record with zero capture decoding errors.
Parsed START/TRIAL/SUMMARY markers from the raw XCTest log and compared the complete objects to the preserved JSONL records.
Compared every summary trial object against the ordered incremental TRIAL records.
Verified manifest.txt and START.manifestASCII are byte-identical, 13,085 ASCII bytes, with the frozen expected SHA-256.
Decoded every canonical length-prefixed manifest field and checked field lengths, delimiters, header and complete consumption.
Independently reconstructed all 12 SplitMix64 object nonces from the frozen seed with wrapping UInt64 arithmetic.
Checked all six condition permutations crossed with A then B, case IDs, option swaps and original answer keys.
Independently reconstructed all 36 complete prompt strings and opposite counterfactual keys; checked ordinal, case ID, condition, expected answer and prompt SHA-256 for every row.
Checked every incremental wrapper binds the frozen manifest digest and pinned GGUF digest.
Parsed all 36 request UUIDs; verified version 4 and uniqueness after UUID canonicalization.
Independently parsed UTF-8 output bytes using only edge whitespace 09/0a/0d/20 and exactly A or B; no semantic word-to-label reinterpretation.
Checked failed rows preserve null raw output, nonempty recorded errors, null parsed answers and zero score; retained failures in fixed denominators.
Checked every row latency is a nonnegative integer; summed observed per-request latencies without converting this into a general performance claim.
Independently recomputed every metric, including failure and invalid counts, fixed-denominator rates, paired wins/losses and specific answer-switch pairs; all matched the summary.
Compared model SHA-256, content-addressed ID, provider, llama.cpp commit and tag, context length and generation parameters against the exact source pins and manifest.
Compared START and SUMMARY offload records; both report CPU requested, zero requested GPU layers, zero offloaded layers and 31 reported layers.
Checked one caller lease before release, zero active use/request/waiting counts, successful lease release and empty model/pending/unloading lists with zero reserved memory afterward.
Checked completed schedule status, all 36 attempts, zero unstarted budget rows, 9,477 ms recorded elapsed time and the unchanged 900-second budget.
Inspected raw XCTest assertions: completed generation count 32 versus required 36, and generation failures 4 versus required zero; one XCTest executed with two failures.

Compared Git blobs for NativeRecipientTextBenchmark.swift at original e47ca2126b2b3e5a067ebd4e44f1bef55f620951 and audited 1a3a9d2813ab8d0a5a6c582b8b93144b63ee4bd5; both are 297ad2438166e08ba3c499dcd9645c6c06a16f47.

completionAndAcceptance.meaningOfRunnerCompleted: The fixed schedule completed within its cooperative budget; it does not assert that every generation request returned text or passed scoring.

failureAccounting.causeStatement: No token IDs or termination reason are present in these records. The audit does not infer EOS, cancellation, decoding failure or model incapacity from the empty-text errors.
failureAccounting.observedError: backendFailed("llama.cpp returned empty text. No token was invented.")

interpretationLimits: All 32 returned strings fail the frozen strict A/B parser; the three cedar strings were not mapped to answer labels.
All fixed-denominator quality metrics are zero; this pilot does not establish useful recipient message following.
Observed provenance metadata and model file hashes are not a cryptographic attestation of the in-memory weights or production authorization.
Hosted macOS execution and its recorded timing are not physical iPhone Air acceptance or general performance measurements.
No benchmark source, parser, thresholds, cases or CI gate were changed by this audit, and no benchmark was retriggered.

recommendedNextExperiment.action: Read and verify the exact pinned GGUF chat template and native special-token handling, then predeclare a separate pilot with exact template bytes, strict A/B scoring and fresh balanced cases. Preserve version 1 unchanged. If termination diagnostics are needed, declare their bounded metadata before the new experiment.
notJustified: GIE mapper training against an unestablished text baseline
